name: Game Runtime Engineering
purpose: Implement main loop, fixed timestep, state updates, and scene management.
inputs: Fixed tick, render interpolation, scene lifecycle, and update-budget contracts
Scene and state inventory, transitions, suspend/resume, resize, and device-loss behavior
Target frame budget, hitch scenarios, determinism oracle, and resource baseline
outputs: Fixed-timestep loop, interpolation, scene stack, and hostile-event recovery
Determinism, tick-spiral, transition, and resource-leak test evidence
Frame-time budget report with traceable overruns
stop_conditions: Identical input scripts produce identical state hashes at fixed tick boundaries
Injected hitches and lifecycle events never cause tick spirals or leaked resources
Token budget exhausted or a required target device is unavailable
